title: Sections and normalized comparisons for orbit tensor descent
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and use the normalized module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. For an endomorphism $b:X\to X$, a module $F$, an open $U$ with $b^{-1}U=U$, and $s\in\Gamma(U,F)$, define its invariant-open pullback as the section $1\otimes s$ transported along this equality of opens. For a finite family of automorphisms $a_h$ and an $a_h$-invariant $U$, define the orbit frame of $s\in\Gamma(U,L)$ by tensoring these pullbacks in the list order used for $N=\bigotimes_h a_h^*L$ [def-sfb-pencil-orbit-bundle-norm]; the empty list has section $1$. Define a pure section of $F^{\otimes d}$ recursively, using $1$ at $d=0$ and the sheaf tensor section at successors. For $q:X\to Y$ and $bq=q$, define $b^*q^*M\simeq q^*M$ as the inverse normalized composition comparison followed by transport along $bq=q$. For a group action, define the unit and composition comparisons by transporting along $a_1=1$ and $a_{gh}=a_h;a_g$ and applying the normalized identity and composition comparisons. These are the seven existing constructions from the parent module, unchanged.
